description: National Full-Scale Testing Infrastructure for Community Hardening in Extreme Wind, Surge, and Wave Events (NICHE): UF PDT Non-Synoptic Testing is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Frank Lombardo, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (illinois.edu). This project is part of a larger effort to design a large-scale facility capable of simulating extreme wind and water events. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Tornado, Thunderstorm, Non-Synoptic, Transient. Published 2025-04-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
